label: preparing
what: A great-hall gathering for this evening, with hospitality/catering of 200 loaves and an eight-lantern hall setup; the baker and innkeeper explicitly coordinate refreshments, while builder and freight assist with preparations. The mayor was kept informed of the scheduled lighting inspection/meeting, but the gathering itself appears to have been organized without a clear prior explanation to him. Neighbour and secretary provide incidental assistance, not clearly shown knowingly helping prepare the gathering itself.
